syntactic_simplification: Mice are important in neuroscience research. Scientists use them to learn about the brain. They can control and study mice easily. Researchers have often chosen male mice for experiments. They did this because female mice have hormone cycles. These cycles can cause changes in behavior. This might affect the results of the experiments.
lexical_simplification: Mice are important in brain science studies. Scientists use them to learn about the brain. They can control and study mice easily. Researchers have often chosen male mice for tests. They did this because female mice have hormone changes. These changes can cause differences in behavior. This might affect the results of the tests.
paraphrase_or_explanation: Mice are important in studies about the brain. Scientists use them to understand how the brain works. They can easily manage and observe mice. Researchers usually pick male mice for their tests. They do this because female mice have hormone changes every month. These changes can cause differences in how the mice act. This could change the outcomes of the tests.
prompt_used: You simplify complex texts for children. The FKGL score of the output (Flesh-Kincaid Grade Level) approximates the reading grade of the text, using the following formula: 0.39 x (words/sentences) + 11.8 x (syllables/words) – 15.59. Target FKGL score of your simplification equals 8.
source_text: Mice have long been a central part of neuroscience research, providing a flexible model that scientists can control and study to learn more about the intricate inner workings of the brain. Historically, researchers have favored male mice over female mice in experiments, in part due to concern that the hormone cycle in females causes behavioral variation that could throw off results.
target_text: Mice are important in studies about the brain. Scientists use them to understand how the brain works. They can easily manage and watch mice. Researchers usually choose male mice for their tests. They do this because female mice have hormone changes every month. These changes can make them act differently. This could change the results of the tests.
